title_as_printed: Experimental Mole Percent CO2 Values for the Initially Dry Gas Mixtures Used in this Study as Determined Gravimetrically and by GC Analysis (x_Gr_CO2 and x_GC_CO2, Respectively), Calculated Densities of Initially Dry Gas Mixtures (rho), and Experimental Values for H2O Concentrations (C_H2O) and Mole Permil (x_H2O) at Saturation in these Mixtures at T = 323.2 K and P = 9.000 MPa

footnotes_as_printed.a: Standard uncertainties u are u(T) = 0.1 K and u(P) = 0.005 MPa.
footnotes_as_printed.b: Measured by the gas vendor. These mole percents are the compositions of the initially dry gas mixtures and have standard uncertainties u(x_Gr_CO2) of 0.03.
footnotes_as_printed.c: GC measurements were performed by Isotech Laboratories Inc. to verify the gravimetrically measured mole percent CO2 values. Up to 1% N2 + O2 at a ratio consistent with air was detected in some of these samples. We assume that this contamination occurred during the sample preparation or GC analysis. na = not analyzed. These mole percents are the compositions of the initially dry gas mixtures and have standard uncertainties u(x_GC_CO2) of 0.2.
footnotes_as_printed.d: Densities were calculated using STOMP-COMP and have standard uncertainties u(rho) better than 0.001 g/mL.
footnotes_as_printed.e: These concentrations are at equilibrium with liquid water. The expanded uncertainties u(C_H2O) and u(x_H2O) have a coverage factor k = 10 and are based on standard deviation of the mean for replicate titrations.

pressure_note: cell pressure 9.000 MPa (pressure transducer); the paper does not say whether this includes the water partial pressure: not stated. Water-saturated CO2-CH4 fluid in equilibrium with liquid water (footnote e).
volume_basis_evidence: C_H2O is printed in mmol.L-1; the paper does not state the volume basis (presumably litres of the water-bearing CO2-CH4 fluid at 323.2 K and 9.000 MPa): not stated

value.what: mole permil of H2O in the CO2-CH4 fluid at saturation with liquid water

value2.what: concentration of H2O in the CO2-CH4 fluid at saturation (measured quantity; x_H2O is derived from it by the authors with STOMP-COMP densities)

composition.other_species: water-saturated CO2-CH4 mixture; no salt. Gas mixture composition is given in gas_composition.

extra_unmapped: rho (g/mL): density of the initially dry gas mixture, calculated with STOMP-COMP (not measured)
x_CO2 GC (%): GC check of composition
notes: Footnote letters of the column headers (b,c,d,e) are repeated in the note column of every row as <column>:<letter>. Rows 0 (0.00 % CO2) and 5 (100.00 % CO2) are pure CH4 and pure CO2 respectively (binary CH4-H2O, CO2-H2O). 'na' kept as printed. The saved capture holds the same printed table twice (three times in the wrapper text); assembled once, the two records have identical cells.
